summary: Iteration 51 - End-to-end UI testing of the new Snippet Library 'click-to-add' flow on real portal JXQ8EYEQ (Wheeler Ridge Residence). Cards are now clickable, modal opens, POST /proposal/extra fires with the correct payload, shift-click repeats last destination, Cancel/Delete-X don't trigger adds, new trade banner appears in proposal. Found 1 small UX bug in initial state of the destination picker when no trades exist on the proposal yet.

ui_bugs.issue: When the proposal has ZERO existing trades (grouped is empty — which is THE CURRENT STATE of JXQ8EYEQ since scope_of_work=[]), the picker initializes `trade` state to '' via `useState(tradeOptions[0] || '')`. The browser visually renders the only option '+ NEW TRADE…' as selected, BUT React state is still '', so `isNewTrade = trade === '__NEW__'` is false, so the snippet-new-trade-input field is NEVER rendered. The user is trapped: TRADE dropdown looks selected, but no input appears, ADD LINE button is disabled (canConfirm=false), and clicking the dropdown to re-pick '+ NEW TRADE…' is the only escape. This is exactly the 'cards don't work' user complaint coming back in a slightly different form. Repro: open SNIPPET LIBRARY on JXQ8EYEQ → click any card → modal opens with TRADE='+ NEW TRADE…' but no input below it → ADD LINE button is greyed out. Fix: change `useState(tradeOptions[0] || '')` to `useState(tradeOptions[0] || '__NEW__')` so the new-trade input appears immediately when there are no trades.

action_items: FIX: SnippetDestinationPicker initial trade state — change line 1222 from `useState(tradeOptions[0] || '')` to `useState(tradeOptions[0] || '__NEW__')` so when the proposal has no trades yet (like JXQ8EYEQ today), the NEW TRADE input is visible immediately on modal open. Without this fix, users on a fresh/empty proposal still cannot add a snippet without realising they have to re-click the dropdown.

POST payload to /api/builder/JXQ8EYEQ/proposal/extra is correct: {parent_kind:'trade-room', parent_id:'TEST_QA_TRADE::TEST_QA_ROOM', name:'Demo - Dumpster (per haul)', quantity:1, unit:'EA', cost:650, markup_percent:15}. Matches the spec in the review request exactly.

Hint text 'Shift-click to repeat last → TEST_QA_TRADE / TEST_QA_ROOM' renders next to the +NEW SNIPPET button after first successful add — confirmed visually.

Cancel button closes modal without firing any POST — confirmed.
Hover effect: translateY(-1px) + box-shadow + gold border (#D4A574) all applied on mouseenter — confirmed via element.style inspection.

Green flash ('✓ ADDED') for 700ms: timing-sensitive; my evaluate() check at +50ms missed it once but the state machine (setFlashId + setTimeout 700ms clear) is correct in code review and the hint-text proof shows lastDest was set (which only happens inside the same `if (ok)` block that sets flashId).
DELETE /api/builder/JXQ8EYEQ/proposal/extra/{id} returned 200 for both test extras — cleanup confirmed, portal extras=0 after cleanup.

Did NOT exercise DnD/rename regressions in this iteration (those were verified in iteration_50 on IL8X4FXJ); since the underlying ProposalView component is the same, no regression expected — but main agent may want to spot-check.

rca of the issue: RCA of initial-state UX bug: SnippetDestinationPicker (line 1222) initializes `trade` state with `useState(tradeOptions[0] || '')`. tradeOptions comes from `grouped.map(g => g.tradeName)` and grouped is empty when the proposal has no scope_of_work yet (current state of JXQ8EYEQ). Empty array yields empty string fallback. The <select> shows '+ NEW TRADE…' visually as first option, but React state is '', which doesn't match '__NEW__', so the conditional render `{isNewTrade && <input data-testid=snippet-new-trade-input/>}` evaluates to false. User sees a select pre-filled with '+ NEW TRADE…' but no input below it and a disabled ADD LINE button (canConfirm requires non-empty finalTrade). Mitigation: change fallback to `'__NEW__'` so isNewTrade becomes true from mount on an empty-trades proposal.
